title: Berry Tonic
desc: Sun-dappled Tuscan travertine meets hand-blown artisanal glass in a secluded villa nook. Sunlight filters through olive foliage, illuminating a vibrant botanical tonic infused with wild berries, while a delicate micro-cloud of aromatic zest and herb dust settles onto glistening ice shards.
businessBrief: Dramatic smoke diffusion and crystal refractivity designed for ultra-premium spirits, cocktail lounges, and barware visual storytelling.
